title: Kya hai sakina
body:
Kya hai sakina
Is baat se mehsoos karo kya hai sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke honton ka qaseeda hai sakina
1. Aaina e zehra mein jo dekha tera bachpan
<<DIVIDER>>
har aks pukara ke tu zehra hai sakina
2. Jo pyaas k parcham ki alamdar hai ab tak
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ki woh pyari sakina hai sakina
3. Abbas ki nazron se koi padh ke to dekhe
<<DIVIDER>>
ehsas ki ek nehjay balagha hai sakina
4. Jo mashk mein bhar sakta hai duniya ke samandar
<<DIVIDER>>
konain mein bas woh tera saqqa hai sakina
5. Har umr k haider ne jhulaya tera jhoola
<<DIVIDER>>
yeh auj faqat tu ne hi paaya hai sakina
6. Daryaon k labno k qalam choom rahay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ne abhi likha nahi socha hai sakina
7. Rehan ki surat woh sar afraz rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ne teri dehleez ko chooma hai sakina
author: Mir Hassan Mir
